How the top impact makers do it
Nothing held back. The moves the leaders at the top of the board made to get there.
Start inside your own org chart
Your number two, your ops lead, your managers. They should hear it from Darren, not secondhand from you. The fastest path to Platinum runs straight through your own leadership team.
A one-line text beats a forwarded link every time. "You're the one I thought of first." Then send your link.
The GM, ops lead and 3 managers
Not ready for April? Gift them The Compound Effect audiobook. A few hours of Darren in their ears does the convincing for you.
Bring the people who make you run
A key vendor, client or partner. A spouse or business partner. Start with the person who knows your numbers best.
Her accountant, a partner and 4 managers
Find the Champion one spot ahead of you on Friday and let them know you're coming for it.

Every leader who takes a seat at the Founders Event because of you. They join through your link, they name you at checkout, or you invest in a seat for one of your own leaders and name them. Each one is one impact.
Started late. Can I still make the Studio?
Yes. Every impact counts the same until the final count. Plenty of the board is still to be decided.
How do I see where I stand?
Your Champion Board shows your rank and how far you moved this week. It updates the moment a leader's seat is confirmed.
A leader says they joined. Where's my credit?
They show on your board as pending right away, and the impact locks in once their seat is confirmed. If it hasn't shown up, reply to any Champion email with their name and we'll sort it out.
Your own seat is your way in. Impacts are the leaders you bring with you.
How is In the Studio awarded?
By rank at the final count: the top-ranked Champions. Every seat is earned by rank and Darren's selection. Nothing is left to chance.
